subject: gk
question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the **correct **options:

**Assertion (A)**: The Happiness Index includes political freedom and social support.

**Reason (R)**: The Index is published by the UNDP.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3: A is true, but R is false**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Happiness Index measures various factors, including **political freedom, social support, income, health, life expectancy, and generosity.**
 
• The Happiness Index is officially known as the **World Happiness Report**, which ranks countries based on these criteria.
 
• **Political freedom and social support** are significant components assessed in this index to evaluate the well-being of individuals in a society.
 
• The World Happiness Report is **not published by the UNDP**; instead, it is prepared by the Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN) under the auspices of the United Nations.
 
• The report is based on data collected from global surveys like the **Gallup World Poll**, emphasizing subjective well-being and happiness levels across countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key UNDP Indices:**

 
 
• Human Development Index (**HDI**): A summary measure of average achievement in:

 
 
• A long and healthy life (Life Expectancy at Birth).
 
• Access to knowledge (Mean Years of Schooling & Expected Years of Schooling).
 
• A decent standard of living (Gross National Income per Capita).
 
 
 
• Multidimensional Poverty Index (**MPI**): Identifies overlapping deprivations in health, education, and living standards (like nutrition, sanitation, electricity, cooking fuel, etc.) for individuals.
 
• Gender Inequality Index (**GII**): Measures gender disparities in reproductive health, empowerment, and economic activity.
 
• Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index (**IHDI**): Accounts for inequality within countries by "discounting" the HDI in proportion to the level of inequality, notes United Nations Development Programme.
 
• Gender Development Index (**GDI**): Compares HDI for men and women.
 
• Planetary Pressures-adjusted HDI (**PHDI**): Adjusts the HDI for environmental impact.
 
• Gender Social Norms Index (**GSNI**): Measures social norms restricting gender equality.
